summary: Master financial cybersecurity and data privacy. Learn NIST CSF, PCI DSS 4.0, and GDPR compliance to protect institutional assets. Expert-led 5-day course.
lede: Cybersecurity training for financial services covers protecting sensitive data, payment systems and connected financial services from cyber threats. It is for security, privacy, risk and compliance professionals who need to assess threats, map security controls, strengthen identity and API security, and prepare for incidents; practical exercises include threat profiling, framework gap analysis, secure API design and third-party risk assessment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for the security, privacy, and regulatory standing of financial entities.
modules: Financial Cyber Threat Landscape and Resilience
Data Privacy Governance and Financial Mandates
Securing Payment Systems and Transaction Infrastructure
Cloud Security and Open Banking APIs
Identity Governance and Zero Trust Architecture
Incident Response and Cyber Crisis Management
Third-Party and Supply Chain Risk Management
AI, Automation, and Emerging Financial Tech
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in IT, risk management, or compliance within a financial services context. Familiarity with basic networking concepts and general data protection principles is recommended. No prior programming knowledge is required, but an understanding of institutional business processes is essential.
